tips.recommendation: Warm-start from a certified MgO donor (sha 917b3bea or 1858f32c) via startpot_overwrite; prefer a Broyden target.
tips.reason: 2 certified same-structure donors; measured 6 vs 178 iters (97%) on a Broyden target (33% on linear).

tips.recommendation: Warm-start from a certified NaCl donor (68ccf55e or cb742fd6); Broyden target.
tips.reason: 2 certified donors; measured 2 vs 171 iters (99%) Broyden target (33% linear). Rocksalt no-empty-sphere.

tips.recommendation: Warm-start from a certified Si donor (diamond + 2 explicit empty spheres, Z-seq [14,14,0,0]).
tips.reason: 2 certified empty-sphere donors; measured 2 vs 119 iters (98%). Empty spheres are explicit/certified.

tips.recommendation: Warm-start from a certified TiSe2 donor (coarse contour); use single-segment gentle mixing.
tips.reason: 2 coarse-converged donors; warm <=100 vs ~1188-1354 cold. CAVEAT: 0-gap semimetal; fine contour destabilizes -> coarse only.

tips.recommendation: Warm-start magnetic runs from a certified Fe/Ni/Co donor (NSPIN=2, LINIPOL init).
tips.reason: 2 certified donors each; warm 5-6 vs ~131-136 iters (~96%); moments basin-matched, direction-symmetric.

tips.recommendation: Warm-start heavy-SOC runs from a certified donor; recipe NCHEB=12 + <USE_CHEBYCHEV_SOLVER>, R_LOG 0.6 (0.8 Pb), voronoi Cheby-free.
tips.reason: 2 certified donors each; warm 2-3 vs 122-136 iters (~97%). SOC routing must be KKR-only (voronoi Chebyshev-free).

tips.recommendation: Do NOT expect a WSe2 donor: setup OK but SCF is unstable (heavy-SOC contour/EMIN) and ~70 min/iter on th1.
tips.reason: Charge-neutrality bounces 6.6->1.3->6.1; process paused. Needs EMIN/contour work + faster hardware. No donor available.

tips.recommendation: Do NOT use the MP0 MoS2 cell (rhombohedral or conventional): Voronoi NACLSD (1502/1615), no donor.
tips.reason: Acute primitive AND 9-atom conventional cell both exceed NACLSD; needs a 2H polytype or larger-NACLSD binary.
